concerns.text: Task T020 (Test Set Partitioning) is scheduled AFTER T031 (RSS Generation). Spec FR-009 mandates partitioning the fixed test set 'at the start of the pipeline' from the 'full dataset' to prevent circular dependency. T031 creates a 30k RSS cap from the filtered pool; if T020 runs after, the test set is drawn from the RSS or filtered pool, violating the 'full dataset' independence requirement and risking data leakage.

Task T031 implements a 30k RSS cap on the training pool. Spec FR-003 requires creating subsamples from the 'full dataset' (>150k). While the Plan justifies this for memory, the task description does not explicitly state that the 7 sparsity levels are subsamples of this 30k RSS, nor does it clarify if the 'full dataset' requirement in FR-003 is being formally waived or redefined. This creates a semantic gap between the spec's 'full dataset' mandate and the task's 'RSS' implementation.

Task T032 generates 7 subsets from the '30k RSS pool'. Spec FR-003 requires subsets to preserve chemical space of the 'full dataset'. If the RSS (30k) is not a perfect stratified representation of the full 150k+, the resulting subsets may fail the 'chemical space distribution' acceptance criterion defined in US-2, Scenario 1, as the base population for stratification is already reduced.

Task T047 implements a 'slope variance < 10%' threshold. Spec US-3 Acceptance Scenario 3 requires 'elbow point varies by no more than 5%'. While FR-007 mentions 10%, the acceptance scenario (the testable verification step) specifies 5%. The task implements the FR text but ignores the stricter acceptance criterion, potentially failing the user story's verification step.

Task T059 proposes updating SC-001 to include 'Predictive Variance' and 'Calibration Slope'. SC-001 is a Success Criterion (measurable outcome). Adding new metrics to a Success Criterion without a corresponding update to the Functional Requirements (FR-005 covers variance, but FR-005 does not explicitly mandate 'Calibration Slope' as a success metric) creates a scope creep where the project must deliver metrics not explicitly authorized by the current FR set.
